title: How Much of a Returned FlexLine Payment Was Replaced
content:
**Tariff note — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit replacement relief.** The cover share follows the replacement payments recorded against the return, added up, measured against the amount returned: the whole amount returned or more gives 1.00; 50% of it or more but less than the whole gives 0.75; less than 50% of it gives 0.50.

The share multiplies the replacement relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent.

| Replacement payments recorded against the return, added up | Share |
|---|---|
| the amount returned or more | 1.00 |
| 50% of the amount returned or more, below the whole | 0.75 |
| below 50% of the amount returned | 0.50 |

*Hypothetical figures (400.00 returned):* replacements of 250.00 and 150.00 total 400.00 (1.00); 200.00 alone is exactly 50% (0.75); 199.99 is below 50% (0.50).
